additional_concerns: The representation reports an unsupported '+' operator or arity. Executable aggregation, threshold inclusivity, exclusions and designation logic cannot be inspected; no particular substantive conflict or omission is established.

The automatic threshold includes exactly 50% and totals direct and indirect exposure. Footnote 7 addresses discretionary assessment below 50%. Designation factors are non-exhaustive considerations, not automatic triggers or substitutes for an SFC designation.

Unknown exposure or designation evidence must remain distinguishable from established absence of a classification basis. A false result cannot establish historical declassification, distribution permission or non-complex status for excluded LAFs.

The source does not specify exposure valuation, look-through, double-counting, designation expiry or automatic declassification after exposure declines. No executable treatment of these unresolved matters is available.
Footnote 1's 15% direct-investment limit is distinct from the aggregate classification threshold. Assessing that separate limit requires the missing UT Code section 7.3.

The separate LAF circular, incorporated product-approval guidance and advertising guidelines are not supplied; they would be required to assess their respective regimes, rather than this narrow classification question. The anonymous missing dependency IDs cannot reliably be mapped to named authorities.
